svg.text: Kestrel Exchange - Basement: cable tunnel and cable chamber (floor y -3.3)
Architectural plan (Phase 1, Phase 2 refinements), docs/prompts/exchange-design.md. Ceiling 3.0 m clear (the MDF hall floor slab over it).
no basement under the rest of the building
(ground-bearing slab; outline of the building above dashed)
CABLE CHAMBER: 9.55 x 11.85, 3.0 m clear (under the MDF hall).
Street cables come in along the tunnel, are held on steel cable bearers
round the walls (brackets at 2.0-2.4 m) and rise through floor slots
into the MDF frames above. A row of cable drums; the sump
(chequer-plate cover) is in the gap at its end.
Basement stair: 20 risers (0.165) in two flights with a half landing,
up to a fire door in the MDF hall.
Column 0.5 square on the 6 m grid
Roller shutter / sealed or locked opening
